title: Jibble Review (2026)
intro: Jibble is evaluated here as a time & attendance / clock-in platform — Jibble is a time & attendance platform for clock-in, timesheets, GPS/geofence, and face recognition. Free forever covers unlimited users with GPS, face recognition, timesheets, and Slack/Teams/QuickBooks integrations. Paid annual seats commonly cited as Premium ~$4.49/user/mo and Ultimate ~$7.99/user/mo (StackArbiter May 2026; medium confidence), with Enterprise custom. Free plan is the headline entry. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Jibble when accurate time & attendance with GPS/face recognition — and a generous free plan — is the primary job.
verdict: Choose Jibble when accurate time & attendance with GPS/face recognition — and a generous free plan — is the primary job. Compare Connecteam for broader frontline WFM, Breezy for ATS hiring, and Trainual for SOP training documentation. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Jibble markets simple mobile/kiosk clock-in with face recognition and GPS — low friction for hourly and field teams. Score from first-party positioning, not lab testing.
Primary job is time & attendance. Strong cluster fit; light scheduling does not make it a Connecteam WFM peer or Breezy ATS peer.
Timesheets, GPS/geofence, face recognition, and attendance policies deliver solid time-attendance workflows; deeper WFM hubs live elsewhere.
Slack, Teams, QuickBooks plus Zapier-style cover common payroll/comms stacks; held at 7 vs broader WFM ecosystems.
GPS and face-recognition clock-in are built for mobile/field attendance — excellent frontline readiness for the time job.
Attendance reporting is present; depth is adequate for SMB time tracking, not workforce analytics suites.
Unlimited free users is a strong start; paid Premium/Ultimate/Enterprise ladder supports policy depth as teams grow.
Free forever unlimited users is an outstanding entry; paid seats ~$4.49–$7.99 annual (medium confidence) keep paid TCO accessible. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful published AI assistant/recommendation packaging comparable to ATS Intelligence or LMS AI credits — scored low on this criterion.

faq.answer: Yes. Jibble is evaluated as time & attendance / clock-in software — distinct from project-management task time tracking.

faq.question: How is Jibble priced?
faq.answer: Free forever unlimited users (GPS, face recognition, timesheets). Paid annual commonly Premium ~$4.49 / Ultimate ~$7.99 per user/mo (medium confidence). Enterprise custom. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Jibble have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. No free trial is documented on the pricing page. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Jibble?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
